journey.name: Payment Request Summary
journey.description: Verifies that the collapsed Payment Request confirmation shows who the request is from and what it is for, keeps the note in the details, and shows "Not specified" in For when the request has no note. Requires two Bitkit instances saved as each other's contacts and linked as identities, with the payer funded to cover 21,000 sats plus fees and local test USDT payments. Before starting, use the local USDT fixture to establish two completed requests in the requester's history: one USD-denominated and one BTC-denominated, each paid in USDT with a verified receipt. Record the USD request amount and each payer activity detail's rounded Payment value for comparison; the amounts need not be equal. Both instances must have USDT enabled. The iOS layout check uses a supported 375-point-wide device with enlarged Dynamic Type; Android uses 320 dp. See README.md.

actions.action: On the requester, send the payer contact a Payment Request for 21,000 sats with the note "Lunch last week"

On the requester, verify completion (id "PaymentRequestSent") says "Sent" with "You have sent a payment request", or "Queued" with "Your payment request is queued and will send automatically"; the title and description must agree
On the payer, verify the Payment Request confirmation screen (id "PaymentRequestConfirm") appears with 21,000 sats without opening the pending Payment Requests bell
Verify From (id "PaymentRequestFrom") shows the requester's contact name
Verify From (id "PaymentRequestFrom") and For (id "PaymentRequestFor") are hidden in details, and the recipient (id "ReviewContactRecipient") under Contact is the requester's contact
Verify the invoice note (id "PaymentRequestInvoiceNote") shows "Lunch last week"
Close the Payment Request confirmation screen without paying
On the requester, send the payer contact a Payment Request for 5,000 sats with no note
On the payer, verify the Payment Request confirmation screen (id "PaymentRequestConfirm") appears automatically with 5,000 sats
Verify From (id "PaymentRequestFrom") shows the requester's contact name and For (id "PaymentRequestFor") shows "Not specified"

Open the prepared USD-denominated request in payment history. On a 375-point-wide iOS screen with enlarged text and a long translated verification status, verify a short contact name such as Maria and every status word remain complete. The amount and receipt may move below the contact when needed. Repeat at the default text size and verify short amounts and statuses remain beside the contact when they fit. For the USD request, verify the receipt equals the request amount. Repeat the layout checks for the prepared BTC-denominated request paid in USDT. Verify its receipt shows the USDT amount with up to six decimals in the selected locale's separator and rounds to the Payment value in the payer's activity detail (shown as less than 0.01 below one cent). Do not compare with the fee-inclusive activity total.
